import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path("calculus/tools").resolve()))
import adopt
import names
for stem in sys.argv[1:] or ["Organisation","Community-Network","Community-Market","Rides","Lodging","Gigs","Liquid-Cooperative"]:
    try:
        output, _ = adopt.compiled(names.name_of(stem))
    except SystemExit as exc:
        print(stem, "failed", exc, flush=True)
        continue
    expected = Path("calculus/contracts", stem, "full-schemas.txt").read_text()
    actual = output["full-schemas.txt"]
    Path(stem + ".schemas").write_text(actual)
    Path(stem + ".term").write_text(output["term.glp.txt"])
    print(stem, actual.strip() == expected.strip(), len(actual.splitlines()), flush=True)
